_comment: Source of truth for the in-app 'update available' sheet. Publish a byte-identical copy to https://saiyedrushan.github.io/hayya-site/version.json once a build is live on the store. Full instructions: CICD.md, 'Announcing a store update'.
notes: A small friend on the home screen — a brother in a kufi or a sister in hijab — whose strength is your last seven days and whose face is the last few hours
Tap the card for the full picture: a day-by-day bar, today’s tally, a shield for a perfect yesterday, a glow for a whole week kept
A Companion widget for the home screen, on both platforms, that keeps up with the day while the app is closed
Nothing about the companion is stored — the prayer log is the only source, so marking a prayer late heals retroactively and unmarking takes it back
The lock screen’s Now and next widget now gives Sunrise its own row while Show sunrise is on
Ticking a card on the adhkar, after-salah, Friday and My duas lists gives a small tap under your finger — Settings → Adhkar → Vibrate on tick turns it off
